name: Stackable Narrow Six-Malign
author: Iliary
description:
串联窄六魔灵
——窄意味着串联火力密度大

去除创伤区域和逻辑之后可单科使用

待机耗布为零

打开开关强制启用布热

-附身魔灵控制集火。
射击时解除附身持续集火,再次附身魔灵停火。

无线供超，无线供布修，串联时在空隙塞修复吧

专用逻辑，不可他用

Stackable Narrow Six-Malign Battery
— "Narrow" means higher firepower density when chained.

Can be used with a single core after removing the scathe zone and logic modules.

Consumes no Phase Fabric while idle.

Enable the switch to force Phase Fabric boosting.

* Possession-Controlled Focus Fire
  Possess a Malign to designate a target.
  Once firing begins, possession is automatically released and the battery continues focusing that target.
  Possess a Malign again to cease fire.

Wireless overdrive. Wireless phase-mending.
When chaining multiple batteries, consider filling the gaps with repair structures.

Dedicated logic. Not intended for other uses.
